method.source: TradingView OANDA:XAUUSD, archived OHLC merged with latest fetched completed candles
method.definition: Entire T1/T2/T3 pattern and all intervening M15 candles fit within an earlier candle high/low including wicks; mother precedes the entire pattern; stop at any missing M15 candle. Inclusive edges with at least one strictly inside edge. Nearest enclosing mother recorded.
method.strategy: Current Scalp 1:1 functions: H4 structure and EMA20/50, H1 continuation/Far, volume decrease >=250, 10/25% pullback legs, original fixed exits, 75-minute entry expiry, 300-pip per-leg limit.
method.counting: One signal is one setup; 10% and 25% entries additionally counted as separate legs. TP/SL setup requires at least one confirmed filled leg and no uncertain or conflicting leg outcome.
method.scope: Chart simulations, not MT5 executions. OHLC ordering ambiguity and missing candles remain uncertain. No spread, commission, slippage or live operational/session restrictions applied. Trading code/settings unchanged.
